summary.text: Kenneth Blevins is the Libertarian candidate for the Oklahoma House of Representatives, District 66, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Clay Staires (R).

paragraphs.text: Kenneth Blevins was born in Tulsa, Oklahoma, and lives in Sand Springs.

He graduated from Charles Page High School, earned an associate degree from Tulsa Community College and a bachelor's degree in athletic training from Oklahoma State University, and has worked as a welder and pipefitter.
Blevins is the chair of the Libertarian Party of Oklahoma.
He was a candidate for U.S. Senate in Oklahoma in 2022, when incumbent James Lankford (R) won, and lost the 2024 general election for Oklahoma House District 66 to incumbent Clay Staires (R).
In a Ballotpedia survey, Blevins listed government accountability, transparency and representation as his key messages.
